title: Hotbar Reworked
description: A hotbar texture pack that gives hotbar a fresh and unique new look.
body:
This texture pack completely redesigns the Minecraft hotbar with a fresh,stylish and polished look.It focuses on improving the visual feel of the interface by giving the hotbar a cleaner layout and a more modern appearance,making your gameplay UI feel unique and refreshed.
